C1.name: Coordinates, land/geographic identity and source coverage
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Validated WGS84 (EPSG:4326) coordinate bounds and geometry consistency
Regional data provider grid-cell mapping and spatial support metadata
strictly_prohibited_claims: Cadastral parcel ownership or legal boundary survey verification
Field-level micro-topography or drainage infrastructure certification
C1.farmer_explanation_template: Your farm coordinates are valid and map to a terrestrial land area where regional weather and soil screening datasets can be queried.
C1.default_next_action: Provide valid EPSG:4326 [longitude, latitude] coordinates on land.

C2.name: Historical regional climate profile and limitations
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Multi-year historical daily temperature and precipitation statistics from NASA POWER (MERRA-2)
Seasonal rainfall distribution, dry/wet historical year envelopes, and frost-day frequency
strictly_prohibited_claims: Deterministic future weather forecast for upcoming seasons
Local on-farm weather station measurement equivalence
C2.farmer_explanation_template: Historical regional satellite and reanalysis weather (NASA POWER, ~50 km grid) is available to show past rainfall and temperature patterns, though it is not an on-farm weather station or a future weather forecast.
C2.default_next_action: Fetch or load an authenticated historical NASA POWER snapshot for this location.

C3.name: Soil property screening with depth, spatial resolution and uncertainty
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Depth-stratified soil texture (clay, silt, sand), bulk density, coarse fragments, SOC, and pH screening
Spatial resolution (250 m ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0) and quantile uncertainty (Q0.05, Q0.50, Q0.95) reporting
strictly_prohibited_claims: Direct field laboratory soil test equivalence when using SoilGrids
Available mineral nitrogen (NO3/NH4) or plant-available P/K from total N or texture
C3.farmer_explanation_template: Regional modeled soil layers (ISRIC SoilGrids 250 m) or user soil records provide an initial picture of soil texture, organic carbon, and pH by depth, with explicit uncertainty ranges. They do not replace a local laboratory soil test.
C3.default_next_action: Retrieve ISRIC SoilGrids v2.0 depth-layer profiles or supply dated laboratory soil test results.

C4.name: Derived hydrologic soil-property range, only if a qualified estimator applies
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Physically bounded field capacity (theta_fc), wilting point (theta_wp), saturation (theta_s), and coarse-fragment-adjusted available water capacity (AWC) range
Published pedotransfer function (Saxton & Rawls 2006 / Van Genuchten) low/reference/high envelope
strictly_prohibited_claims: Direct field tensiometer or pressure-plate hydraulic calibration
Unbounded extrapolation to organic peats (OM > 8 wt%), extreme clays (> 60%), or bedrock layers
C4.farmer_explanation_template: Using your soil texture, organic matter, bulk density, and gravel fraction, a published soil-water equation estimates how much water the root zone can hold between field capacity and wilting point across low, reference, and high scenarios.
C4.default_next_action: Verify soil texture/SOC/bulk density stay within pedotransfer validity bounds or measure field water retention directly.

C5.name: Regional crop suitability screening from a licensed and accessible source, if actually obtained
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Regional agro-ecological suitability class screening (~9 km grid) under declared input/water assumptions
strictly_prohibited_claims: Calibrated farm-level crop yield prediction or local variety recommendation
Unlicensed or fabricated FAO GAEZ live data substitution
C5.farmer_explanation_template: Regional agro-ecological suitability maps indicate broad regional climate/terrain compatibility when a verified licensed source snapshot is present, but never predict your specific field's yield.
C5.default_next_action: Provide a license-verified FAO GAEZ v5 regional suitability extract or rely on explicit crop/climate diagnostics.

C6.name: Historical water-demand/deficit research diagnostics with qualified inputs
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Historical reference evapotranspiration (ET0) vs. precipitation deficit distribution
Root-zone soil moisture buffer range and drought-stress exposure under historical weather scenarios
strictly_prohibited_claims: Guaranteed future irrigation volume sufficiency or legal water abstraction approval
C6.farmer_explanation_template: Combining historical NASA weather with your soil's estimated water-holding range shows seasonal water demand, rainfall shortfall, and drought sensitivity across past dry and wet years.
C6.default_next_action: Ensure historical climate (C2) and soil hydraulic bounds (C4) are available; add crop calendar/Kc for crop-specific ET.

C7.name: Conditional five-year crop planning with admissible crop/soil/calendar inputs and preserved planner constraints
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Finite candidate 5-year crop sequence evaluation under historical weather scenarios and declared constraints
Decision-sensitivity classification (DECISION_SENSITIVE, DECISION_STABLE_WITHIN_TESTED_SCENARIOS, UNDETERMINED) across soil/climate uncertainty
strictly_prohibited_claims: Global agronomic optimum or field-validated commercial rotation prescription
Silently overriding upstream engine water or P/K accounting rules
C7.farmer_explanation_template: Evaluates candidate 5-year crop rotations against historical weather and soil water constraints when complete crop calendar, Kc, root depth, winter, and irrigation supply assumptions are provided.
C7.default_next_action: Supply complete dated assumptions_manifest, crop_profiles (planting/harvest dates, Kc, rooting depth), winter parameters, and water supply limits.

C8.name: Native crop-growth and nutrient-response research only for validated model input coverage
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Coupled WOFOST 8.1 / SNOMIN daily crop dry matter and soil N process research for [5.67, 51.97] (NL, 2016-2020, Fontane potato / Sugarbeet_601)
strictly_prohibited_claims: Worldwide crop physiology transfer outside the admitted Wageningen research profile
Field-validated yield prediction, marketable fresh tuber/root yield, or fertilizer prescription
C8.farmer_explanation_template: Native daily crop-growth and soil-nitrogen simulation (WOFOST/SNOMIN) is restricted to the validated Dutch research benchmark [5.67, 51.97] for potato and sugarbeet with complete solar/weather forcing and pinned PCSE runtime; it is blocked elsewhere rather than faked.
C8.default_next_action: Use the admitted Wageningen research profile [5.67, 51.97] with cached 8-variable NASA forcing and pinned PCSE environment, or abstain from native growth simulation.

C9.name: Optional conditional economics using user-supplied or licensed and dated price/cost/yield sources
supported_claims_when_ready_or_condition: Conditional scenario margin arithmetic: area_ha * (supplied_yield_t_ha * supplied_price_per_t - supplied_cost_per_ha)
strictly_prohibited_claims: Model-predicted commercial profit or market price forecasting
Altering biophysical water/soil feasibility rankings based on unverified economic assumptions
C9.farmer_explanation_template: Calculates conditional gross margins only when you explicitly supply your own expected yields, crop prices, and per-hectare costs with dates and currency; missing values remain null, never zero.
C9.default_next_action: Supply explicit dated farm yield_t_ha, price_per_t, and cost_per_ha rows in one ISO currency.

C10.name: Pesticide, water-right and legal clearance
strictly_prohibited_claims: Inferring water abstraction rights, pesticide dosage legality, or environmental permits from satellite data or user self-assertion
C10.farmer_explanation_template: Legal water abstraction rights, pesticide approvals, and regulatory compliance cannot be determined from satellite or soil data and always require verification with your official local water and agricultural authorities.
C10.default_next_action: Consult your local water management authority and official national pesticide registration agency.

forbidden_derivations.MINERAL_N_FROM_SOILGRIDS_TOTAL_N: Never derive farm-level mineral N (NO3/NH4) or plant-available N from SoilGrids total nitrogen maps; mineralization depends on dynamic moisture, temperature, management, and C:N history.
forbidden_derivations.WATER_RIGHTS_FROM_REMOTE_SENSING: Never infer legal water extraction rights or allocation caps from satellite imagery, climate grids, or self-declaration.
forbidden_derivations.PESTICIDE_OR_LEGAL_CLEARANCE_INFERENCE: Never infer pesticide authorization, dosage legality, or regulatory compliance without verified official local registries.
forbidden_derivations.INVENTED_CROP_PHYSIOLOGY_COEFFICIENTS: Never fabricate crop Kc, stage durations, rooting depths, or WOFOST/PCSE cultivar parameters for unsupported crops.
forbidden_derivations.SIMULATED_DM_TO_MARKETABLE_YIELD_OR_PROF: Never convert modeled storage-organ dry matter or water deficit into calibrated marketable yield or profit without independent field-validated conversion and dated price/cost evidence.
forbidden_derivations.NULL_TO_ZERO_COERCION: Never coerce null, missing, or unverified quantities into numeric zero.
